{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个高于所属客户分群平均金额的已完成订单","sources":["fact_orders","dim_customers"],"joins":["fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id","相关子查询中 fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id"],"filters":["外层及相关子查询均限定 fact_orders.status = 'completed'","total_amount > segment_avg_amount"],"metrics":["segment_avg_amount = 同分群已完成订单 total_amount 的平均值"],"steps":["连接订单与客户以取得 segment","用引用外层 segment 的相关子查询计算分群平均金额","筛选高于分群平均金额的订单","按 total_amount 降序、order_id 升序排序"],"risks":["使用订单头 total_amount；若其与订单行净额不一致，结果受数据质量异常影响","相关子查询按结果订单重复计算，可能影响大数据量下的性能"]},"sql":"SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    segment,
    total_amount,
    segment_avg_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.segment,
        o.total_amount,
        (
            SELECT AVG(o2.total_amount)
            FROM fact_orders AS o2
            JOIN dim_customers AS c2
              ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id
            WHERE o2.status = 'completed'
              AND c2.segment = c.segment
        ) AS segment_avg_amount
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    JOIN dim_customers AS c
      ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
) AS completed_orders
WHERE total_amount > segment_avg_amount
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, order_id ASC","summary":"连接已完成订单与客户，并通过引用外层客户分群的相关子查询计算同分群已完成订单平均金额，再筛选高于该平均值的订单并按指定顺序排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个品类内排名前三的商品","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_products"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_order_items.product_id = dim_products.product_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","ROW_NUMBER 排名不超过 3"],"metrics":["net_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)"],"steps":["按 category、product_id、product_name 汇总净销售额","按品类以净销售额降序、product_id 升序计算 ROW_NUMBER","保留 rank_no <= 3","按 category、rank_no 升序输出"],"risks":["先聚合再排名，避免订单行粒度重复","product_id 作为同额时的确定性排序键"]},"sql":"WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_order_items AS oi
    JOIN fact_orders AS o
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_products AS p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY
        p.category,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        product_id,
        product_name,
        net_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, product_id ASC
        ) AS rank_no
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    net_revenue,
    rank_no
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rank_no <= 3
ORDER BY category ASC, rank_no ASC","summary":"汇总完成订单中各商品的净销售额，再按品类使用 ROW_NUMBER 选取净销售额最高的三个商品，并以 product_id 升序打破同额并列。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每月一行（2025 年有已完成订单行的月份）","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'","fact_orders.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"],"metrics":["monthly_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","cumulative_revenue = SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)"],"steps":["按订单月份汇总订单行净销售额","使用按 month 排序的 SUM 窗口计算累计收入","按 month 升序输出"],"risks":["先按月聚合再计算窗口，避免窗口作用于订单行粒度","不生成无已完成订单的月份"]},"sql":"WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        strftime(fact_orders.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(
            fact_order_items.quantity * fact_order_items.unit_price
            - fact_order_items.discount_amount
        ) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM fact_orders
    JOIN fact_order_items
        ON fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id
    WHERE fact_orders.status = 'completed'
      AND fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND fact_orders.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    month,
    monthly_revenue,
    SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (
        ORDER BY month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month ASC","summary":"汇总 2025 年已完成订单的月度订单行净销售额，再用按月份排序的 SUM 窗口计算累计收入。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"2025 年每个自然月一行，共 12 行","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","generate_series 生成 2025 月份序列"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","月份序列 LEFT JOIN 月度收入聚合"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND fact_orders.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"],"metrics":["monthly_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)，无收入月份补 0","mom_pct = ROUND((monthly_revenue / LAG(monthly_revenue) - 1) * 100, 2)"],"steps":["生成 2025 年 12 个月份","按订单月份聚合完成订单行净销售额","补齐无收入月份并使用 LAG 取得上月收入","计算环比百分比并按 month 升序输出"],"risks":["上月收入为 0 时使用 NULLIF 避免除零，环比返回 NULL","先聚合订单行再连接月份序列，避免收入重复计算"]},"sql":"WITH month_spine AS (
    SELECT month_start
    FROM generate_series(
        DATE '2025-01-01',
        DATE '2025-12-01',
        INTERVAL '1 month'
    ) AS months(month_start)
),
monthly_aggregation AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month_start,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_series AS (
    SELECT
        ms.month_start,
        COALESCE(ma.monthly_revenue, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 2))) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM month_spine AS ms
    LEFT JOIN monthly_aggregation AS ma
        ON ma.month_start = ms.month_start
),
with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        monthly_revenue,
        LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_series
)
SELECT
    strftime(month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    monthly_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (monthly_revenue - previous_month_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_month_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS mom_pct
FROM with_previous
ORDER BY month_start ASC;","summary":"生成 2025 年完整月份序列，汇总完成订单的订单行净销售额，补零后使用 LAG 计算月度环比。","assumptions":["无收入月份的 monthly_revenue 记为 0；若上月收入为 0，则环比无定义并返回 NULL。"]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个符合条件的客户","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_customers"],"joins":["fact_orders.order_id = fact_order_items.order_id","客户消费汇总.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","客户 total_spend > 有已完成订单客户的平均 total_spend"],"metrics":["total_spend = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","平均累计消费 = AVG(客户 total_spend)"],"steps":["内层子查询按 customer_id 汇总已完成订单行净销售额","中层子查询计算有已完成订单客户的平均累计消费","外层连接客户维表并筛选高于平均值的客户","按 total_spend 降序、customer_id 升序排序"],"risks":["先按客户聚合，避免订单行连接导致客户重复","仅有已完成订单的客户进入平均值计算","DECIMAL 平均值类型由 DuckDB 推导"]},"sql":"SELECT
    customer_spend.customer_id,
    customers.customer_name,
    customer_spend.total_spend
FROM (
    SELECT
        orders.customer_id,
        SUM(items.quantity * items.unit_price - items.discount_amount) AS total_spend
    FROM fact_orders AS orders
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS items
        ON orders.order_id = items.order_id
    WHERE orders.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY orders.customer_id
) AS customer_spend
INNER JOIN dim_customers AS customers
    ON customer_spend.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE customer_spend.total_spend > (
    SELECT AVG(spend_by_customer.total_spend)
    FROM (
        SELECT
            orders.customer_id,
            SUM(items.quantity * items.unit_price - items.discount_amount) AS total_spend
        FROM fact_orders AS orders
        INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS items
            ON orders.order_id = items.order_id
        WHERE orders.status = 'completed'
        GROUP BY orders.customer_id
    ) AS spend_by_customer
)
ORDER BY customer_spend.total_spend DESC, customer_spend.customer_id ASC","summary":"先按客户汇总已完成订单行的净销售额，再与同一客户集合的平均累计消费比较，连接客户名称后输出并排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个渠道类型一行","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_payments"],"joins":["fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id","fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id"],"filters":[],"metrics":["paid_amount：status='paid' 的支付金额之和","refunded_amount：status='refunded' 的支付金额之和","failed_amount：status='failed' 的支付金额之和"],"steps":["连接渠道、订单与支付","按 channel_type 分组","使用三组 SUM(CASE WHEN ...) 聚合","按 channel_type 升序排序"],"risks":["多笔支付按支付记录分别计入对应状态","无支付记录的渠道类型不会输出"]},"sql":"SELECT

{"plan":{"grain":"每个商品品类一行","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_products","fact_returns"],"joins":["订单行按 order_id 连接订单","订单行按 product_id 连接商品","退货按 order_id、line_no 连接订单行","品类汇总结果按 category 连接"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["sold_qty：完成订单行 quantity 之和","returned_qty：完成订单退货 return_qty 之和","return_rate：returned_qty / sold_qty，四舍五入 4 位"],"steps":["按品类聚合完成订单售出数量","独立按品类聚合完成订单退货数量","连接两个品类级汇总并计算退货率","按 return_rate 降序、category 升序排序"],"risks":["退货明细不得与售出明细在同一聚合中直接连接","无退货品类需补零","使用 NULLIF 防止除零"]},"sql":"WITH sold_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty
    FROM fact_order_items AS oi
    JOIN fact_orders AS o
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_products AS p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
),
returned_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(r.return_qty) AS returned_qty
    FROM fact_returns AS r
    JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
      ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
     AND r.line_no = oi.line_no
    JOIN fact_orders AS o
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_products AS p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
    s.category,
    s.sold_qty,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)::DECIMAL / NULLIF(s.sold_qty, 0),
        4
    ) AS return_rate
FROM sold_by_category AS s
LEFT JOIN returned_by_category AS r
  ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, s.category ASC","summary":"分别在品类粒度汇总完成订单的售出量和退货量，再连接汇总结果计算退货率，从而避免明细连接引起的 fan-out。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个存在金额差异的订单","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["fact_orders LEFT JOIN fact_order_items ON order_id"],"filters":["stored_total - calculated_total <> 0"],"metrics":["stored_total = ROUND(total_amount, 2)","calculated_total = ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount), 2)","difference = ROUND(stored_total - calculated_total, 2)"],"steps":["按订单汇总订单行净额","以 0 表示无订单行的 calculated_total","筛选差异订单","按绝对差异降序、order_id 升序"],"risks":["一对多连接必须先按 order_id 聚合","缺失订单行需保留以发现异常","使用精确 DECIMAL 运算并四舍五入 2 位"]},"sql":"WITH reconciled AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ROUND(o.total_amount, 2) AS stored_total,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS calculated_total
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY
        o.order_id,
        o.total_amount
), differences AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        stored_total,
        calculated_total,
        ROUND(stored_total - calculated_total, 2) AS difference
    FROM reconciled
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    stored_total,
    calculated_total,
    difference
FROM differences
WHERE difference <> 0
ORDER BY
    ABS(difference) DESC,
    order_id ASC","summary":"按订单汇总订单行净额，与订单头金额比较，仅输出非零差异，并按绝对差异降序排列。","assumptions":["没有订单行的订单按 calculated_total = 0 处理，以便识别为数据质量异常。"]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个 channel_type 一行","sources":["fact_payments","fact_orders","dim_channels"],"joins":["fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id"],"filters":[],"metrics":["SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'paid' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_amount","SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'refunded' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount","SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'failed' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount"],"steps":["按订单关联渠道类型","按 channel_type 分组并进行三组条件聚合","按 channel_type 升序排序"],"risks":["不连接订单行，避免支付记录因订单行一对多被重复计算"]},"sql":"SELECT
    dim_channels.channel_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'paid' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'refunded' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'failed' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount
FROM fact_payments
JOIN fact_orders
    ON fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id
JOIN dim_channels
    ON fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id
GROUP BY dim_channels.channel_type
ORDER BY dim_channels.channel_type ASC","summary":"按订单关联渠道类型，对支付记录按状态进行三组 SUM(CASE WHEN ...) 条件聚合，并按渠道类型升序输出。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个商品品类一行","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_products","fact_returns"],"joins":["订单行按 order_id 连接完成订单","订单行按 product_id 连接商品品类","退货按 order_id、line_no 连接订单行"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["sold_qty = SUM(quantity)","returned_qty = SUM(return_qty)","return_rate = returned_qty / sold_qty，四舍五入4位"],"steps":["先按品类聚合完成订单售出数量","先按订单行聚合退货数量，再按品类聚合","关联两组品类聚合并计算退货率","按退货率降序、品类升序排序"],"risks":["退货记录先按订单行汇总，避免明细连接产生 fan-out","使用 NULLIF 防止售出数量为零"]},"sql":"WITH sold_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
),
returns_by_line AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        r.line_no,
        SUM(r.return_qty) AS returned_qty
    FROM fact_returns AS r
    GROUP BY r.order_id, r.line_no
),
returned_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(COALESCE(rl.returned_qty, 0)) AS returned_qty
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN returns_by_line AS rl
        ON rl.order_id = oi.order_id
       AND rl.line_no = oi.line_no
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
    s.category,
    s.sold_qty,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(s.sold_qty, 0), 4) AS return_rate
FROM sold_by_category AS s
LEFT JOIN returned_by_category AS r
    ON r.category = s.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, s.category ASC;","summary":"使用独立的完成订单售出量和退货量聚合，并先按订单行汇总退货，避免 fan-out；随后按品类计算并排序退货率。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个订单一行（最新成功支付）","sources":["fact_payments"],"joins":[],"filters":["fact_payments.status = 'paid'","ROW_NUMBER() = 1"],"metrics":["输出 payment_id、paid_at、amount"],"steps":["按 order_id 分组","按 paid_at 降序、payment_id 降序编号","保留每组 ROW_NUMBER() = 1","按 order_id 升序输出"],"risks":["同一订单同一 paid_at 时以 payment_id 降序确定最新记录"]},"sql":"WITH ranked_paid_payments AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        payment_id,
        paid_at,
        amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_id
            ORDER BY paid_at DESC, payment_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM fact_payments
    WHERE status = 'paid'
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_id,
    paid_at,
    amount
FROM ranked_paid_payments
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY order_id ASC;","summary":"筛选成功支付记录，使用 ROW_NUMBER 按订单分组并按支付时间、payment_id 倒序选取最新一笔，最终按 order_id 升序输出。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个 2026 年已完成订单","sources":["fact_orders"],"joins":[],"filters":["order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'","order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'","status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["order_id","total_amount","CASE 分层为 high、medium、low"],"steps":["筛选 2026 年已完成订单","使用 CASE 计算 amount_band","按 total_amount 降序、order_id 升序"],"risks":["检查金额边界 2000 和 1000 的归类"]},"sql":"SELECT
    order_id,
    total_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN total_amount >= 2000 THEN 'high'
        WHEN total_amount >= 1000 AND total_amount < 2000 THEN 'medium'
        ELSE 'low'
    END AS amount_band
FROM fact_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
  AND status = 'completed'
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, order_id ASC;","summary":"筛选 2026 年已完成订单，使用 CASE 按 total_amount 分为 high、medium、low，并按金额降序及订单号升序输出。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个渠道一行","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["dim_channels.channel_id = fact_orders.channel_id","fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["completed_order_count：完成订单去重计数","net_revenue：完成订单商品行净销售额"],"steps":["按渠道聚合完成订单数和订单行净销售额","左连接渠道维表以保留无完成订单渠道","空值填 0 并按 channel_id 升序"],"risks":["仅使用订单行净额计算 net_revenue，不使用订单头 total_amount","不连接支付和退货表，避免指标重复计算"]},"sql":"SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    COALESCE(m.completed_order_count, 0) AS completed_order_count,
    COALESCE(m.net_revenue, 0.00) AS net_revenue
FROM dim_channels AS c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        o.channel_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count,
        SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - i.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS i
        ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.channel_id
) AS m
    ON m.channel_id = c.channel_id
ORDER BY c.channel_id ASC;","summary":"以渠道维表为主表左连接完成订单聚合，保留所有渠道；完成订单数按订单去重计数，净销售额按完成订单商品行净额汇总，空值填 0 后按渠道 ID 升序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个 channel_type 一行","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_order_items","fact_payments"],"joins":["订单与渠道：fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id","订单行与订单：fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","支付与订单：fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","各指标先按 channel_type 独立聚合，避免订单行与支付记录相乘"],"filters":["订单指标仅统计 fact_orders.status = 'completed'","支付金额按 fact_payments.status 分类，不额外过滤订单状态"],"metrics":["completed_order_count：完成订单去重计数","net_revenue：完成订单订单行净额汇总","paid_amount：status='paid' 的支付金额","refunded_amount：status='refunded' 的支付金额","failed_amount：status='failed' 的支付金额"],"steps":["获取全部 channel_type","独立聚合完成订单数与净销售额","独立聚合三类支付金额","按 channel_type 左连接并补零","按 channel_type 升序输出"],"risks":["订单行和支付记录直接连接会造成重复计算，已通过独立聚合规避","支付表中同一订单可有多笔支付，按支付记录金额汇总"]},"sql":"WITH channel_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT channel_type
    FROM dim_channels
),
order_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.channel_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    JOIN dim_channels AS c
        ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.channel_type
),
payment_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.channel_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'paid' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount
    FROM fact_payments AS p
    JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN dim_channels AS c
        ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    GROUP BY c.channel_type
)
SELECT
    ct.channel_type,
    COALESCE(om.completed_order_count, 0) AS completed_order_count,
    COALESCE(om.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue,
    COALESCE(pm.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_amount,
    COALESCE(pm.refunded_amount, 0) AS refunded_amount,
    COALESCE(pm.failed_amount, 0) AS failed_amount
FROM channel_types AS ct
LEFT JOIN order_metrics AS om
    ON ct.channel_type = om.channel_type
LEFT JOIN payment_metrics AS pm
    ON ct.channel_type = pm.channel_type
ORDER BY ct.channel_type ASC","summary":"先分别按 channel_type 聚合完成订单订单行指标与支付状态金额，再汇总连接并按 channel_type 升序输出，避免订单行与支付记录连接导致重复计算。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个商品品类一行","sources":["dim_products","fact_order_items","fact_orders"],"joins":["dim_products.product_id = fact_order_items.product_id","fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["net_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","revenue_share_pct = net_revenue / 全部品类净销售额 * 100，四舍五入 2 位"],"steps":["按品类汇总完成订单商品行净销售额","计算全部品类净销售额","计算并四舍五入占比","按占比降序、品类升序排序"],"risks":["使用 NULLIF 防止全部品类净销售额为零时除零"]},"sql":"WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - i.discount_amount), 0) AS net_revenue
    FROM dim_products AS p
    LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS i
        ON p.product_id = i.product_id
    LEFT JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON i.order_id = o.order_id
       AND o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_revenue) AS total_net_revenue
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT
    cr.category,
    cr.net_revenue,
    ROUND(cr.net_revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_net_revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM category_revenue AS cr
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC, cr.category ASC;","summary":"按品类汇总完成订单商品行净销售额，并以全部品类净销售额为分母计算四舍五入至 2 位的百分比，最后按占比降序和品类升序排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个存在金额差异的订单","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["fact_orders.order_id = fact_order_items.order_id"],"filters":["仅保留 difference <> 0"],"metrics":["stored_total = ROUND(fact_orders.total_amount, 2)","calculated_total = ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount), 2)","difference = ROUND(stored_total - calculated_total, 2)"],"steps":["按订单汇总订单行净额","关联订单头金额并计算差异","过滤差异订单并排序"],"risks":["无订单行的订单按订单行净额 0 处理"]},"sql":"WITH order_line_totals AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount) AS calculated_total_raw
    FROM fact_order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
), reconciliation AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ROUND(o.total_amount, 2) AS stored_total,
        ROUND(COALESCE(olt.calculated_total_raw, 0), 2) AS calculated_total,
        ROUND(o.total_amount - COALESCE(olt.calculated_total_raw, 0), 2) AS difference
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN order_line_totals AS olt
        ON o.order_id = olt.order_id
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    stored_total,
    calculated_total,
    difference
FROM reconciliation
WHERE difference <> 0
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC, order_id ASC;","summary":"按订单汇总订单行净额，与订单头 total_amount 对账，保留四舍五入到 2 位后存在差异的订单，并按绝对差异降序、订单号升序排列。","assumptions":[]}
